namespace SSIVerification

def Hash : Type := Nat
def Position : Type := Nat
def Token : Type := Nat

structure Segment where
  tokens : List Token
  position : Position
  score : Nat
  anchorHash : Hash
deriving Repr, BEq

structure CollisionNode where
  seg : Segment
  next : List CollisionNode
deriving Repr

inductive Node where
  | leaf (hash : Hash) (segment : Option Segment) (collisionChain : List CollisionNode)
  | internal (hash : Hash) (height : Nat) (children : List (Option Node))
deriving Repr

structure SSI where
  root : Option Node
  height : Nat
  size : Nat
  maxHeight : Nat
deriving Repr

structure SSIStats where
  nodes : Nat
  leaves : Nat
  depth : Nat
deriving Repr

structure RankedSegment where
  tokens : List Token
  score : Nat
  position : Position
  anchor : Bool
deriving Repr

structure SerializedSSI where
  height : Nat
  size : Nat
  segments : List Segment
deriving Repr

structure AbstractHash where
  compute : List Token → Position → Hash

variable (ahash : AbstractHash)

def nodeHash : Node → Hash
  | Node.leaf h _ _ => h
  | Node.internal h _ _ => h

def nodeIsLeaf : Node → Bool
  | Node.leaf _ _ _ => Bool.true
  | Node.internal _ _ _ => Bool.false

def nodeSegment : Node → Option Segment
  | Node.leaf _ seg _ => seg
  | Node.internal _ _ _ => Option.none

def nodeCollisionChain : Node → List CollisionNode
  | Node.leaf _ _ chain => chain
  | Node.internal _ _ _ => []

def nodeChildren : Node → List (Option Node)
  | Node.leaf _ _ _ => []
  | Node.internal _ _ ch => ch

def nodeHeight : Node → Nat
  | Node.leaf _ _ _ => 0
  | Node.internal _ h _ => h

def segmentEqPosition (seg : Segment) (pos : Position) : Bool :=
  BEq.beq seg.position pos

def collisionChainLength : List CollisionNode → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: rest => 1 + collisionChainLength rest

def countLeaves : Node → Nat
  | Node.leaf _ _ _ => 1
  | Node.internal _ _ children =>
    List.foldl
      (fun acc child =>
        match child with
        | Option.none => acc
        | Option.some n => acc + countLeaves n)
      0
      children

def countNodes : Node → Nat
  | Node.leaf _ _ _ => 1
  | Node.internal _ _ children =>
    1 + List.foldl
      (fun acc child =>
        match child with
        | Option.none => acc
        | Option.some n => acc + countNodes n)
      0
      children

def treeDepth : Node → Nat
  | Node.leaf _ _ _ => 0
  | Node.internal _ _ children =>
    1 + List.foldl
      (fun acc child =>
        match child with
        | Option.none => acc
        | Option.some n => Nat.max acc (treeDepth n))
      0
      children

def xorBits (a b : Nat) : Nat := Nat.xor a b

def popCount : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _ => 0
  | Nat.succ remaining, n => (n % 2) + popCount remaining (n / 2)

def hammingDistance (h1 h2 : Nat) : Nat :=
  popCount 64 (xorBits h1 h2)

def computeSimilarityNat (h1 h2 : Nat) : Nat :=
  64 - hammingDistance h1 h2

def clampHeight (h : Nat) : Nat :=
  Nat.min h 6

def pow2 : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | Nat.succ n => 2 * pow2 n

def computeBucket (segHash : Nat) (height : Nat) : Nat :=
  segHash % (pow2 height)

def childHashXor : List (Option Node) → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | Option.none :: rest => childHashXor rest
  | Option.some n :: rest => Nat.xor (nodeHash n) (childHashXor rest)

def segmentHash (seg : Segment) : Hash :=
  ahash.compute seg.tokens seg.position

def emptySSI (maxH : Nat) : SSI :=
  { root := Option.none, height := 0, size := 0, maxHeight := maxH }

def lookupInChain : List CollisionNode → Position → Option Segment
  | [], _ => Option.none
  | c :: rest, pos =>
    if segmentEqPosition c.seg pos then Option.some c.seg
    else lookupInChain rest pos

def lookupSegment : Node → Position → Option Segment
  | Node.leaf _ seg chain, pos =>
    match seg with
    | Option.some s =>
      if segmentEqPosition s pos then Option.some s
      else lookupInChain chain pos
    | Option.none => lookupInChain chain pos
  | Node.internal _ _ children, pos =>
    List.foldl
      (fun acc child =>
        match acc with
        | Option.some x => Option.some x
        | Option.none =>
          match child with
          | Option.none => Option.none
          | Option.some n => lookupSegment n pos)
      Option.none
      children

def ssiGetSegment (ssi : SSI) (pos : Position) : Option Segment :=
  match ssi.root with
  | Option.none => Option.none
  | Option.some root => lookupSegment root pos

def collectAllSegments : Node → List Segment
  | Node.leaf _ seg chain =>
    let base :=
      match seg with
      | Option.some s => [s]
      | Option.none => []
    List.append base (List.map (fun c => c.seg) chain)
  | Node.internal _ _ children =>
    List.foldl
      (fun acc child =>
        match child with
        | Option.none => acc
        | Option.some n => List.append acc (collectAllSegments n))
      []
      children

def ssiCollectAll (ssi : SSI) : List Segment :=
  match ssi.root with
  | Option.none => []
  | Option.some root => collectAllSegments root

def replaceAt : List (Option Node) → Nat → Option Node → List (Option Node)
  | [], _, _ => []
  | _ :: tl, 0, val => val :: tl
  | hd :: tl, Nat.succ k, val => hd :: replaceAt tl k val

def makeChildren (numSlots : Nat) : List (Option Node) :=
  List.replicate numSlots Option.none

def trieInsert (root : Option Node) (seg : Segment) (segHash : Hash) (maxH : Nat) (currentHeight : Nat) : Node × Nat :=
  match maxH with
  | 0 =>
    match root with
    | Option.none =>
      (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) [], currentHeight)
    | Option.some (Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg oldChain) =>
      if oldHash = segHash then
        match oldSeg with
        | Option.some os =>
          if os.position = seg.position then
            (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) oldChain, currentHeight)
          else
            let cn : CollisionNode := { seg := seg, next := [] }
            (Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg (cn :: oldChain), currentHeight)
        | Option.none =>
          (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) oldChain, currentHeight)
      else
        (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) [], currentHeight)
    | Option.some (Node.internal h ht ch) =>
      (Node.internal h ht ch, currentHeight)
  | Nat.succ remaining =>
    match root with
    | Option.none =>
      let effectiveHeight := clampHeight (remaining + 1)
      let numSlots := pow2 effectiveHeight
      let bucket := computeBucket segHash effectiveHeight
      let childRes := trieInsert Option.none seg segHash remaining currentHeight
      let childNode := childRes.1
      let newH := childRes.2
      let children := replaceAt (makeChildren numSlots) bucket (Option.some childNode)
      let newHeight := Nat.max (remaining + 1) newH
      (Node.internal 0 (remaining + 1) children, newHeight)
    | Option.some (Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg oldChain) =>
      if oldHash = segHash then
        match oldSeg with
        | Option.some os =>
          if os.position = seg.position then
            (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) oldChain, currentHeight)
          else
            let cn : CollisionNode := { seg := seg, next := [] }
            (Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg (cn :: oldChain), currentHeight)
        | Option.none =>
          (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) oldChain, currentHeight)
      else
        let effectiveHeight := clampHeight (remaining + 1)
        let numSlots := pow2 effectiveHeight
        let oldBucket := computeBucket oldHash effectiveHeight
        let newBucket := computeBucket segHash effectiveHeight
        let oldLeaf := Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg oldChain
        let newLeaf := Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) []
        let children1 := replaceAt (makeChildren numSlots) oldBucket (Option.some oldLeaf)
        let children2 := replaceAt children1 newBucket (Option.some newLeaf)
        (Node.internal 0 (remaining + 1) children2, currentHeight)
    | Option.some (Node.internal h ht ch) =>
      let effectiveHeight := clampHeight ht
      let bucket := computeBucket segHash effectiveHeight
      let oldChild := List.get? ch bucket
      let flatChild :=
        match oldChild with
        | Option.some c => c
        | Option.none => Option.none
      let childRes := trieInsert flatChild seg segHash remaining currentHeight
      let newChild := childRes.1
      let newH := childRes.2
      let newChildren := replaceAt ch bucket (Option.some newChild)
      (Node.internal h ht newChildren, newH)

def addSequenceAbstract (ssi : SSI) (tokens : List Token) (position : Position) (isAnchor : Bool) : SSI :=
  let anchorH := if isAnchor then ahash.compute tokens position else 0
  let seg : Segment := { tokens := tokens, position := position, score := 0, anchorHash := anchorH }
  let segH := ahash.compute tokens position
  let insertRes := trieInsert ssi.root seg segH ssi.maxHeight ssi.height
  let newRoot := insertRes.1
  let newHeight := insertRes.2
  { root := Option.some newRoot, height := newHeight, size := ssi.size + 1, maxHeight := ssi.maxHeight }

def ssiCompact (ssi : SSI) : SSI :=
  if Nat.ble 1000 ssi.size then
    { root := Option.some (Node.internal 0 ssi.height []),
      height := ssi.height,
      size := 0,
      maxHeight := ssi.maxHeight }
  else ssi

def log2Floor : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 0
  | n + 2 => 1 + log2Floor ((n + 2) / 2)

def ssiBalance (ssi : SSI) : SSI :=
  if Nat.ble 1024 ssi.size then
    { root := ssi.root, height := log2Floor ssi.size + 1, size := ssi.size, maxHeight := ssi.maxHeight }
  else ssi

def updateChainScore : List CollisionNode → Position → Nat → List CollisionNode
  | [], _, _ => []
  | c :: rest, pos, newScore =>
    if c.seg.position = pos then
      { seg := { tokens := c.seg.tokens, position := c.seg.position, score := newScore, anchorHash := c.seg.anchorHash }, next := c.next } :: rest
    else
      c :: updateChainScore rest pos newScore

def updateSegmentInNode : Node → Position → Nat → Node
  | Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) chain, pos, newScore =>
    if seg.position = pos then
      Node.leaf h (Option.some { tokens := seg.tokens, position := seg.position, score := newScore, anchorHash := seg.anchorHash }) chain
    else
      Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) (updateChainScore chain pos newScore)
  | Node.leaf h Option.none chain, _, _ =>
    Node.leaf h Option.none chain
  | Node.internal h ht children, pos, newScore =>
    let effectiveHeight := clampHeight ht
    let bucket := computeBucket pos effectiveHeight
    let updatedChildren :=
      List.map
        (fun p =>
          let i := p.1
          let child := p.2
          if i = bucket then
            match child with
            | Option.none => Option.none
            | Option.some n => Option.some (updateSegmentInNode n pos newScore)
          else child)
        children.enum
    Node.internal h ht updatedChildren

def ssiUpdateScore (ssi : SSI) (position : Position) (newScore : Nat) : Option SSI :=
  match ssi.root with
  | Option.none => Option.none
  | Option.some root =>
    let newRoot := updateSegmentInNode root position newScore
    Option.some { root := Option.some newRoot, height := ssi.height, size := ssi.size, maxHeight := ssi.maxHeight }

def mergeCollectSegments : Node → List (Segment × Bool)
  | Node.leaf _ (Option.some seg) chain =>
    (seg, seg.anchorHash ≠ 0) :: List.map (fun c => (c.seg, c.seg.anchorHash ≠ 0)) chain
  | Node.leaf _ Option.none chain =>
    List.map (fun c => (c.seg, c.seg.anchorHash ≠ 0)) chain
  | Node.internal _ _ children =>
    List.foldl
      (fun acc child =>
        match child with
        | Option.none => acc
        | Option.some n => List.append acc (mergeCollectSegments n))
      []
      children

def ssiMerge (ssi1 : SSI) (ssi2 : SSI) : SSI :=
  let otherSegments :=
    match ssi2.root with
    | Option.none => []
    | Option.some root => mergeCollectSegments root
  List.foldl
    (fun acc p =>
      let seg := p.1
      let isAnch := p.2
      addSequenceAbstract ahash acc seg.tokens seg.position isAnch)
    ssi1
    otherSegments

def splitSegments (segs : List Segment) (threshold : Nat) : List Segment :=
  List.foldl
    (fun acc seg =>
      if Nat.ble (threshold + 1) seg.score then List.append acc [seg] else acc)
    []
    segs

def ssiSplit (ssi : SSI) (threshold : Nat) : SSI :=
  let allSegs := ssiCollectAll ssi
  let filtered := splitSegments allSegs threshold
  List.foldl
    (fun acc seg =>
      addSequenceAbstract ahash acc seg.tokens seg.position (decide (seg.anchorHash ≠ 0)))
    (emptySSI ssi.maxHeight)
    filtered

def insertIntoHeap (heap : List RankedSegment) (rs : RankedSegment) (k : Nat) : List RankedSegment :=
  if heap.length < k then
    rs :: heap
  else
    match heap with
    | [] => [rs]
    | worst :: rest =>
      let minScore := List.foldl (fun acc r => Nat.min acc r.score) worst.score rest
      if rs.score > minScore then
        let filtered := List.filter (fun r => Nat.ble (minScore + 1) r.score) heap
        rs :: filtered
      else heap

def traverseCollect : Node → List (Segment × Nat)
  | Node.leaf _ (Option.some seg) chain =>
    (seg, seg.score) :: List.map (fun c => (c.seg, c.seg.score)) chain
  | Node.leaf _ Option.none chain =>
    List.map (fun c => (c.seg, c.seg.score)) chain
  | Node.internal _ _ children =>
    List.foldl
      (fun acc child =>
        match child with
        | Option.none => acc
        | Option.some n => List.append acc (traverseCollect n))
      []
      children

def retrieveTopKAbstract (ssi : SSI) (queryHash : Hash) (k : Nat) : List RankedSegment :=
  match ssi.root with
  | Option.none => []
  | Option.some root =>
    let allPairs := traverseCollect root
    let ranked :=
      List.map
        (fun p =>
          let seg := p.1
          let sim := computeSimilarityNat queryHash (ahash.compute seg.tokens seg.position)
          { tokens := seg.tokens, score := sim, position := seg.position, anchor := (seg.anchorHash ≠ 0) : RankedSegment })
        allPairs
    List.foldl (fun acc rs => insertIntoHeap acc rs k) [] ranked

def validLeafHash : Node → Prop
  | Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) _ => h = ahash.compute seg.tokens seg.position
  | Node.leaf _ Option.none _ => False
  | Node.internal _ _ _ => True

def validInternalHash : Node → Prop
  | Node.leaf _ _ _ => True
  | Node.internal h _ children => h = childHashXor children

def validNode : Node → Prop
  | Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) _ => h = ahash.compute seg.tokens seg.position
  | Node.leaf _ Option.none _ => False
  | Node.internal h _ children => h = childHashXor children

def allNodesValid : Node → Prop
  | Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) _ => h = ahash.compute seg.tokens seg.position
  | Node.leaf _ Option.none _ => False
  | Node.internal h _ children =>
    h = childHashXor children ∧
    List.foldr
      (fun child acc =>
        match child with
        | Option.none => acc
        | Option.some n => allNodesValid n ∧ acc)
      True
      children

def ssiValid (ssi : SSI) : Prop :=
  match ssi.root with
  | Option.none => True
  | Option.some root => allNodesValid ahash root

def computeStats (ssi : SSI) : SSIStats :=
  match ssi.root with
  | Option.none => { nodes := 0, leaves := 0, depth := 0 }
  | Option.some root => { nodes := countNodes root, leaves := countLeaves root, depth := treeDepth root }

def serializeAbstract (ssi : SSI) : SerializedSSI :=
  { height := ssi.height, size := ssi.size, segments := ssiCollectAll ssi }

def deserializeAbstract (s : SerializedSSI) (maxH : Nat) : SSI :=
  List.foldl
    (fun acc seg =>
      addSequenceAbstract ahash acc seg.tokens seg.position (decide (seg.anchorHash ≠ 0)))
    (emptySSI maxH)
    s.segments

theorem nat_beq_refl (n : Nat) : BEq.beq n n = true :=
  Nat.recOn n
    (Eq.refl true)
    (fun _ ih => ih)

theorem nat_ble_true_of_le (a b : Nat) (h : a ≤ b) : Nat.ble a b = true :=
  match Nat.decLe a b with
  | Decidable.isTrue _ => Eq.refl true
  | Decidable.isFalse hnle => absurd h hnle

theorem nat_ble_false_of_lt (a b : Nat) (h : b < a) : Nat.ble a b = false :=
  match Nat.decLe a b with
  | Decidable.isTrue hle => absurd (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h hle) (Nat.lt_irrefl b)
  | Decidable.isFalse _ => Eq.refl false

theorem emptySSI_root_none (maxH : Nat) :
    (emptySSI maxH).root = Option.none :=
  Eq.refl Option.none

theorem emptySSI_size_zero (maxH : Nat) :
    (emptySSI maxH).size = 0 :=
  Eq.refl 0

theorem emptySSI_height_zero (maxH : Nat) :
    (emptySSI maxH).height = 0 :=
  Eq.refl 0

theorem emptySSI_maxHeight (maxH : Nat) :
    (emptySSI maxH).maxHeight = maxH :=
  Eq.refl maxH

theorem emptySSI_heightBounded (maxH : Nat) :
    (emptySSI maxH).height ≤ (emptySSI maxH).maxHeight :=
  Nat.zero_le maxH

theorem leaf_isLeaf (h : Hash) (seg : Option Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    nodeIsLeaf (Node.leaf h seg chain) = Bool.true :=
  Eq.refl Bool.true

theorem internal_isNotLeaf (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) (ch : List (Option Node)) :
    nodeIsLeaf (Node.internal h ht ch) = Bool.false :=
  Eq.refl Bool.false

theorem leaf_height_zero (h : Hash) (seg : Option Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    nodeHeight (Node.leaf h seg chain) = 0 :=
  Eq.refl 0

theorem internal_height (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) (ch : List (Option Node)) :
    nodeHeight (Node.internal h ht ch) = ht :=
  Eq.refl ht

theorem leaf_hash (h : Hash) (seg : Option Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    nodeHash (Node.leaf h seg chain) = h :=
  Eq.refl h

theorem internal_hash (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) (ch : List (Option Node)) :
    nodeHash (Node.internal h ht ch) = h :=
  Eq.refl h

theorem leaf_segment (h : Hash) (seg : Option Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    nodeSegment (Node.leaf h seg chain) = seg :=
  Eq.refl seg

theorem internal_no_segment (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) (ch : List (Option Node)) :
    nodeSegment (Node.internal h ht ch) = Option.none :=
  Eq.refl Option.none

theorem leaf_no_children (h : Hash) (seg : Option Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    nodeChildren (Node.leaf h seg chain) = [] :=
  Eq.refl []

theorem internal_children (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) (ch : List (Option Node)) :
    nodeChildren (Node.internal h ht ch) = ch :=
  Eq.refl ch

theorem leaf_collision_chain (h : Hash) (seg : Option Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    nodeCollisionChain (Node.leaf h seg chain) = chain :=
  Eq.refl chain

theorem internal_collision_chain (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) (ch : List (Option Node)) :
    nodeCollisionChain (Node.internal h ht ch) = [] :=
  Eq.refl []

theorem collisionChainLength_nil :
    collisionChainLength [] = 0 :=
  Eq.refl 0

theorem collisionChainLength_cons (c : CollisionNode) (rest : List CollisionNode) :
    collisionChainLength (c :: rest) = 1 + collisionChainLength rest :=
  Eq.refl (1 + collisionChainLength rest)

theorem countLeaves_leaf (h : Hash) (seg : Option Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    countLeaves (Node.leaf h seg chain) = 1 :=
  Eq.refl 1

theorem countNodes_leaf (h : Hash) (seg : Option Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    countNodes (Node.leaf h seg chain) = 1 :=
  Eq.refl 1

theorem treeDepth_leaf (h : Hash) (seg : Option Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    treeDepth (Node.leaf h seg chain) = 0 :=
  Eq.refl 0

theorem countLeaves_internal_nil (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) :
    countLeaves (Node.internal h ht []) = 0 :=
  Eq.refl 0

theorem countNodes_internal_nil (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) :
    countNodes (Node.internal h ht []) = 1 :=
  Eq.refl 1

theorem treeDepth_internal_nil (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) :
    treeDepth (Node.internal h ht []) = 1 :=
  Eq.refl 1

theorem ssiGetSegment_empty (maxH : Nat) (pos : Position) :
    ssiGetSegment (emptySSI maxH) pos = Option.none :=
  Eq.refl Option.none

theorem ssiCollectAll_empty (maxH : Nat) :
    ssiCollectAll (emptySSI maxH) = [] :=
  Eq.refl []

theorem segmentEqPosition_refl (seg : Segment) :
    segmentEqPosition seg seg.position = true :=
  nat_beq_refl seg.position

theorem lookupInChain_nil (pos : Position) :
    lookupInChain [] pos = Option.none :=
  Eq.refl Option.none

theorem lookupSegment_leaf_match (h : Hash) (seg : Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    lookupSegment (Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) chain) seg.position = Option.some seg :=
  show (if segmentEqPosition seg seg.position then Option.some seg else lookupInChain chain seg.position) = Option.some seg from
    have hpos : segmentEqPosition seg seg.position = true := segmentEqPosition_refl seg
    Eq.subst
      (motive := fun b => (if b then Option.some seg else lookupInChain chain seg.position) = Option.some seg)
      (Eq.symm hpos)
      (Eq.refl (Option.some seg))

theorem lookupSegment_internal_nil (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) (pos : Position) :
    lookupSegment (Node.internal h ht []) pos = Option.none :=
  Eq.refl Option.none

theorem collectAllSegments_leaf_some (h : Hash) (seg : Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    collectAllSegments (Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) chain) =
    List.append [seg] (List.map (fun c => c.seg) chain) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem collectAllSegments_leaf_none (h : Hash) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    collectAllSegments (Node.leaf h Option.none chain) =
    List.append [] (List.map (fun c => c.seg) chain) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem collectAllSegments_internal_nil (h : Hash) (ht : Nat) :
    collectAllSegments (Node.internal h ht []) = [] :=
  Eq.refl []

theorem countNodes_pos (n : Node) : 0 < countNodes n :=
  match n with
  | Node.leaf _ _ _ => Nat.succ_pos 0
  | Node.internal _ _ ch =>
      Nat.succ_pos (List.foldl
        (fun acc child =>
          match child with
          | Option.none => acc
          | Option.some n => acc + countNodes n)
        0
        ch)

theorem xorBits_self (n : Nat) : xorBits n n = 0 :=
  Nat.xor_self n

theorem xorBits_comm (a b : Nat) : xorBits a b = xorBits b a :=
  Nat.xor_comm a b

theorem hammingDistance_self (h : Nat) : hammingDistance h h = 0 :=
  show popCount 64 (xorBits h h) = 0 from
    have hxor : xorBits h h = 0 := xorBits_self h
    Eq.subst (motive := fun x => popCount 64 x = 0) (Eq.symm hxor) (Eq.refl 0)

theorem hammingDistance_comm (a b : Nat) : hammingDistance a b = hammingDistance b a :=
  congrArg (popCount 64) (xorBits_comm a b)

theorem computeSimilarityNat_self (h : Nat) : computeSimilarityNat h h = 64 :=
  show 64 - hammingDistance h h = 64 from
    have hh : hammingDistance h h = 0 := hammingDistance_self h
    Eq.subst (motive := fun x => 64 - x = 64) (Eq.symm hh) (Eq.refl 64)

theorem computeSimilarityNat_comm (a b : Nat) : computeSimilarityNat a b = computeSimilarityNat b a :=
  congrArg (fun x => 64 - x) (hammingDistance_comm a b)

theorem computeBucket_zero (segHash : Nat) :
    computeBucket segHash 0 = 0 :=
  Nat.mod_one segHash

theorem clampHeight_le_six (h : Nat) : clampHeight h ≤ 6 :=
  Nat.min_le_right h 6

theorem clampHeight_le_h (h : Nat) : clampHeight h ≤ h :=
  Nat.min_le_left h 6

theorem clampHeight_of_le_six (h : Nat) (hle : h ≤ 6) : clampHeight h = h :=
  Nat.min_eq_left hle

theorem clampHeight_of_ge_six (h : Nat) (hge : 6 ≤ h) : clampHeight h = 6 :=
  Nat.min_eq_right hge

theorem childHashXor_nil : childHashXor [] = 0 :=
  Eq.refl 0

theorem validLeaf_some (h : Hash) (seg : Segment) (chain : List CollisionNode) :
    nodeSegment (Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) chain) ≠ Option.none :=
  fun absurdity => Option.noConfusion absurdity

theorem ssi_state_dichotomy (ssi : SSI) :
    (ssi.root = Option.none) ∨ (∃ n : Node, ssi.root = Option.some n) :=
  match ssi.root with
  | Option.none => Or.inl (Eq.refl Option.none)

deriving Repr

def replaceAt : List (Option Node) → Nat → Option Node → List (Option Node)
  | [], _, _ => []
  | _ :: tl, 0, val => val :: tl
  | hd :: tl, Nat.succ k, val => hd :: replaceAt tl k val

def makeChildren (numSlots : Nat) : List (Option Node) :=
  List.replicate numSlots Option.none

def trieInsert (root : Option Node) (seg : Segment) (segHash : Hash) (maxH : Nat) (currentHeight : Nat) : Node × Nat :=
  match maxH with
  | 0 =>
    match root with
    | Option.none =>
      (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) [], currentHeight)
    | Option.some (Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg oldChain) =>
      if oldHash = segHash then
        match oldSeg with
        | Option.some os =>
          if os.position = seg.position then
            (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) oldChain, currentHeight)
          else
            let cn : CollisionNode := { seg := seg, next := [] }
            (Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg (cn :: oldChain), currentHeight)
        | Option.none =>
          (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) oldChain, currentHeight)
      else
        (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) [], currentHeight)
    | Option.some (Node.internal h ht ch) =>
      (Node.internal h ht ch, currentHeight)
  | Nat.succ remaining =>
    match root with
    | Option.none =>
      let effectiveHeight := clampHeight (remaining + 1)
      let numSlots := pow2 effectiveHeight
      let bucket := computeBucket segHash effectiveHeight
      let childRes := trieInsert Option.none seg segHash remaining currentHeight
      let childNode := childRes.1
      let newH := childRes.2
      let children := replaceAt (makeChildren numSlots) bucket (Option.some childNode)
      let newHeight := Nat.max (remaining + 1) newH
      (Node.internal 0 (remaining + 1) children, newHeight)
    | Option.some (Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg oldChain) =>
      if oldHash = segHash then
        match oldSeg with
        | Option.some os =>
          if os.position = seg.position then
            (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) oldChain, currentHeight)
          else
            let cn : CollisionNode := { seg := seg, next := [] }
            (Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg (cn :: oldChain), currentHeight)
        | Option.none =>
          (Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) oldChain, currentHeight)
      else
        let effectiveHeight := clampHeight (remaining + 1)
        let numSlots := pow2 effectiveHeight
        let oldBucket := computeBucket oldHash effectiveHeight
        let newBucket := computeBucket segHash effectiveHeight
        let oldLeaf := Node.leaf oldHash oldSeg oldChain
        let newLeaf := Node.leaf segHash (Option.some seg) []
        let children1 := replaceAt (makeChildren numSlots) oldBucket (Option.some oldLeaf)
        let children2 := replaceAt children1 newBucket (Option.some newLeaf)
        (Node.internal 0 (remaining + 1) children2, currentHeight)
    | Option.some (Node.internal h ht ch) =>
      let effectiveHeight := clampHeight ht
      let bucket := computeBucket segHash effectiveHeight
      let oldChild := List.get? ch bucket
      let flatChild :=
        match oldChild with
        | Option.some c => c
        | Option.none => Option.none
      let childRes := trieInsert flatChild seg segHash remaining currentHeight
      let newChild := childRes.1
      let newH := childRes.2
      let newChildren := replaceAt ch bucket (Option.some newChild)
      (Node.internal h ht newChildren, newH)

def addSequenceAbstract (ssi : SSI) (tokens : List Token) (position : Position) (isAnchor : Bool) : SSI :=
  let anchorH := if isAnchor then ahash.compute tokens position else 0
  let seg : Segment := { tokens := tokens, position := position, score := 0, anchorHash := anchorH }
  let segH := ahash.compute tokens position
  let insertRes := trieInsert ssi.root seg segH ssi.maxHeight ssi.height
  let newRoot := insertRes.1
  let newHeight := insertRes.2
  { root := Option.some newRoot, height := newHeight, size := ssi.size + 1, maxHeight := ssi.maxHeight }

  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 0

def updateChainScore : List CollisionNode → Position → Nat → List CollisionNode
  | [], _, _ => []
  | c :: rest, pos, newScore =>
    if c.seg.position = pos then
      { seg := { tokens := c.seg.tokens, position := c.seg.position, score := newScore, anchorHash := c.seg.anchorHash }, next := c.next } :: rest
    else
      c :: updateChainScore rest pos newScore

def updateSegmentInNode : Node → Position → Nat → Node
  | Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) chain, pos, newScore =>
    if seg.position = pos then
      Node.leaf h (Option.some { tokens := seg.tokens, position := seg.position, score := newScore, anchorHash := seg.anchorHash }) chain
    else
      Node.leaf h (Option.some seg) (updateChainScore chain pos newScore)
  | Node.leaf h Option.none chain, _, _ =>
    Node.leaf h Option.none chain
  | Node.internal h ht children, pos, newScore =>
    let effectiveHeight := clampHeight ht
    let bucket := computeBucket pos effectiveHeight
    let updatedChildren :=
      List.map
        (fun p =>
          let i := p.1
          let child := p.2
          if i = bucket then
            match child with
            | Option.none => Option.none
            | Option.some n => Option.some (updateSegmentInNode n pos newScore)
          else child)
        children.enum
    Node.internal h ht updatedChildren

  | Option.none => Option.none

    Option.some { root := Option.some newRoot, height := ssi.height, size := ssi.size, maxHeight := ssi.maxHeight }

  | Node.leaf _ Option.none chain =>

  | Node.internal _ _ children =>
    List.foldl

      []

  List.foldl

def insertIntoHeap (heap : List RankedSegment) (rs : RankedSegment) (k : Nat) : List RankedSegment :=
  if heap.length < k then
    rs :: heap
  else
    match heap with
    | [] => [rs]
    | worst :: rest =>
      let minScore := List.foldl (fun acc r => Nat.min acc r.score) worst.score rest
      if rs.score > minScore then
        let filtered := List.filter (fun r => Nat.ble (minScore + 1) r.score) heap
        rs :: filtered
      else heap

    List.map (fun c => (c.seg, c.seg.score)) chain
  | Node.internal _ _ children =>
    List.foldl
      (fun acc child =>
        match child with
        | Option.none => acc
        | Option.some n => List.append acc (traverseCollect n))
      []
      children

def retrieveTopKAbstract (ssi : SSI) (queryHash : Hash) (k : Nat) : List RankedSegment :=
  match ssi.root with
  | Option.none => []
  | Option.some root =>
    let allPairs := traverseCollect root
    let ranked :=
      List.map
        (fun p =>
          let seg := p.1
          let sim := computeSimilarityNat queryHash (ahash.compute seg.tokens seg.position)
          { tokens := seg.tokens, score := sim, position := seg.position, anchor := (seg.anchorHash ≠ 0) : RankedSegment })
        allPairs
    List.foldl (fun acc rs => insertIntoHeap acc rs k) [] ranked
